description_en: Queries the details of client certificates or server certificates in batch by certificate serial number
description_zh: 通过证书的序列号批量查询客户端证书或服务端证书的详细信息
name: DescribeClientCertificateForSerialNumber

parameters.help_en:
The serial numbers of the client certificates or server certificates that you want to query. Separate multiple serial numbers with commas (,).

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/330884.html to query the serial numbers of all client certificates and server certificates
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的客户端证书或服务端证书的序列号。多个序列号之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/330884.html查询所有客户端证书和服务端证书的序列号
parameters.name: serial_number

CertificateList.description_en: The details of the client certificates or server certificates
CertificateList.description_zh: 客户端证书或服务端证书的详细信息

AfterDate.description_en: The expiration date of the certificate. The format is YYYY-MM-DD

Algorithm.description_en:
The encryption algorithm type of the certificate. Valid values:

RSA: RSA algorithm.
ECC: ECC algorithm.
SM2: SM2 algorithm
Algorithm.description_zh:
证书的加密算法类型。取值：

RSA：表示RSA算法。
ECC：表示ECC算法。
SM2：表示SM2（国密）算法

BeforeDate.description_en: The issuance date of the certificate. The format is YYYY-MM-DD

CommonName.description_en: The common name of the certificate

CountryCode.description_en:
The code of the country where the organization associated with the subordinate CA certificate that issued this certificate is located.

For more information about country codes, see the International codes section in [Manage company information]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198289.html）
CountryCode.description_zh:
签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构所在国家的代码。

关于不同国家代码的含义，请参见[管理公司信息]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198289.html）中的**国际代号**章节

Identifier.description_en: The unique identifier of the certificate

KeySize.description_en: The key length of the certificate

Locality.description_en: The name of the city where the organization associated with the subordinate CA certificate that issued this certificate is located
Locality.description_zh: 签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构所在城市的名称

Md5.description_en: The MD5 fingerprint of the certificate

Organization.description_en: The name of the organization associated with the subordinate CA certificate that issued this certificate
Organization.description_zh: 签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构的名称

OrganizationUnit.description_en: The name of the department in the organization associated with the subordinate CA certificate that issued this certificate
OrganizationUnit.description_zh: 签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构下部门的名称

ParentIdentifier.description_en: If this parameter is not empty, the client certificate is issued by Alibaba Cloud
ParentIdentifier.description_zh: 如果该参数不为空，代表该客户端证书的颁发机构为阿里云

Sans.description_en:
The Subject Alternative Name (SAN) extension of the certificate, which indicates other domain names or IP addresses associated with the certificate.

This parameter is represented as a string converted from a JSON array. Each element in the JSON array is a structure that corresponds to a SAN extension. Each SAN extension structure contains the following parameters:

Type: An Integer value that indicates the type of the extension. Valid values:
1: an email address.
2: a domain name.
6: a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI).
7: an IP address.
Value: A String value that indicates the content of the extension
Sans.description_zh:
证书的SAN（Subject Alternative Name）扩展属性，表示证书关联的其他域名、IP地址等。

该参数使用JSON数组转化的字符串表示。JSON数组中的每个元素是一个结构体，对应一个SAN扩展。
每个SAN扩展结构体包含以下参数：

Type：Integer类型，表示扩展的类型。取值：
1：表示邮箱地址。
2：表示域名。
6：表示统一资源标志符URI（Uniform Resource Identifier）。
7：表示IP地址。
Value：String类型，表示扩展的内容

SerialNumber.description_en: The serial number of the certificate

Sha2.description_en: The SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate

SignAlgorithm.description_en: The signature algorithm of the certificate

State.description_en:
<props="china">The name of the province, municipality, or autonomous region where the organization associated with the subordinate CA certificate that issued this certificate is located.</props>
<props="intl">The name of the province or state where the organization associated with the subordinate CA certificate that issued this certificate is located.</props>
State.description_zh:
<props="china">签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构所在省份、直辖市或自治区的名称。</props>
<props="intl">签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构所在省份或州的名称。</props>

Status.description_en:
The status of the certificate. Valid values:

ISSUE: issued.
REVOKE: revoked
Status.description_zh:
证书的状态。取值：

ISSUE：表示正常签发。
REVOKE：表示已被吊销

SubjectDN.description_en:
The distinguished name (DN) attribute of the certificate, which indicates the subject of the certificate. The DN contains the following information:

C: The country.
O: The organization.
OU: The department.
L: The city.
<props="china">- ST: The province, municipality, or autonomous region.</props>
<props="intl">- ST: The province or state.</props>
CN: The common name
SubjectDN.description_zh:
证书的DN（Distinguished Name）属性，表示证书的使用者，具体包含以下信息：

C：国家。
O：组织机构。
OU：部门。
L：城市。
<props="china">- ST：省份、直辖市或自治区。</props>
<props="intl">- ST：省份或州。</props>
CN：公用名

Years.description_en: The validity period of the certificate. Unit: years
